name: Lightning Pitcher
power: Thunderbolt Throw – Add 2 to any pitch roll.
description: When you use this power, roll a d6. On 4-6 the pitch gets a +2 bonus. On 1-3 the pitcher strains and loses a momentum die.

name: Mystic Catcher
power: Ghostly Glove – Negate one out at a time.
description: Roll a d6. 5-6 negates the out, 1-4 the catcher is injured and loses a momentum die.

name: Dragon Slugger
power: Fire Blast – Turn any hit into a home run.
description: Roll a d6. 6 = home run, otherwise the batter is knocked out and loses a momentum die.

name: Arcane Shortstop
power: Time Warp – Re‑roll a failed steal.
description: Roll a d6. 4-6 allows a re‑roll, 1-3 the shortstop trips and loses a momentum die.

name: Shadow Outfielder
power: Phantom Leap – Catch any ball in the air.
description: Roll a d6. 5-6 makes the catch, 1-4 the outfielder is bruised and loses a momentum die.
